normal.name: Grid Gremlin
normal.text: Hot take: the best part of old multiplayer games was dying first. You got to spectate and narrate everyone else's mistakes. Lightcycle games are perfect for it, since every crash is visible from the overhead view. Which game was most fun to watch after you'd lost? #gaming #retrogaming

normal.name: Gregly
normal.text: Did it ever bother anybody else that Final Fantasy 10’s “sphere grid” was about as far from a “grid” as you can get? 😅 GRIDS DO NOT WORK THAT WAY, SQUEENIX #RetroGaming #finalfantasy

normal.name: Ishambard
normal.text: I would not have expected that a game with a box art like this would be the thing to spike my blood pressure... Koneko MonoGatari: The adventures of Chatran is a deceptively hard game, from cheap enemies to pixel perfect jumps. I shall endeavour as always, but if you want to make someone suffer you should challenge them to play this game. #RetroGaming #FamicomDiskSystem

normal.name: Johnny.rtf
normal.text: So. Roc’n Rope. I expect old arcade games to be difficult, but even by those standards this game is mean. But I’m having just enough fun to keep trying, so perhaps one of these days I’ll get the hang of it. Or I’ll rage-quit and go play Timber instead. One of the two. #ArcadeGames #RetroGaming

normal.name: James | PixelRefresh.com
normal.text: My website Pixel Refresh, covering retro gaming & modern tech has had... well a refresh! This year marked its 20th year anniversary and there are many improvements visually speaking with a brand new theme as well as a good tidy and clear out under the hood. I hope you enjoy the website and here's to the next 20 years! #RetroGaming
